title: The Lock-in Hypothesis: Stagnation by Algorithm
reasoning: The study specifically focuses on 'value-laden concepts' which it defines as those related to morality, politics, and religion. Its methodology involves filtering datasets for these specific topics, and its simulations utilize moral and ethical propositions (e.g., regarding Utilitarianism, lying, and animal rights) to observe how human-AI interaction leads to the 'lock-in' of specific beliefs.
